items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: he would introduce me to Jake Hanna, Joe Jones.

ctx.x: But I played the final ceremony there, and then I took that picture, and now in the bookshop and when you get off you see the whole history of Governor’s Island, but I’m © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

one of the last guys from the Army that was there. But then we were transferred over the Staten Island and we were the first Army band, which is in that picture with me in front of the barracks. And then once the first Army was transferred down to Fort Monroe, Virginia, the second Army because the first Army and we became the New York Army Band. So that was the New York Army Band. But I would get the Staten Island Ferry and go see Sonny. But he would schedule the lessons so it would be the last lesson of the day,…
